{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Rebar → `uShearLinksRebar`
{{% /callout %}}

Places shear links (stirrups) in a beam or column, with hook-plane and standard-hook handling matched to Tekla's own hooks. Leg lengths are outside dimensions and the start and end offsets are bar-surface covers. The tool passes its native suite (3490 checks) and an end-to-end insert and modify test on Tekla 2026.

<blockquote class="page-note">The Tekla plugin string is <code>uShearLinksRebar</code>. Components placed by the earlier Clone builds (<code>uShearLinksRebarClone</code>) may not be recognised by it; see <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">Upgrading from the earlier Clone builds</a>. Sets saved under the earlier dialog name are carried over with the <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">preset migration helper</a>.</blockquote>
